requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

weight_management_program.text:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 10/08/2025
S: 48 y/o F wants to lose weight; knees and energy bothering her. Evening snacking, large portions. Has a stationary bike in the basement she hasn't used.
O: Wt 113.1 kg, Ht 172 cm, BMI 38.2. BP 122/76.
Exam unremarkable.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 38.2 — plan starting today:
 - Portion-controlled plate method with a daily food diary, ~1400 kcal/day.
 - Stationary bike 30–40 minutes 5 days a week.
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program.
 Follow-up visits planned.
2. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.

TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER — 01/09/2026
Pt called to reschedule missed dietitian visit. States she "fell off" the meal plan over the holidays and hasn't been on the bike or walking since Thanksgiving. Will try to get back on track in the new year. Dietitian visit rescheduled for March (first available).

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 03/13/2026
Returning after a break. Restarting meal plan — portion-controlled plate method with a daily food diary, ~1400 kcal/day. Reviewed barriers (holiday travel, caregiving for mother).
Resuming exercise: walking and stationary bike, starting 3x/week and building up.
Follow-up in 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/17/2026
S: Follow-up. Has been on and off with the meal plan and exercise since last fall — stopped over the holidays, restarted in March, and more consistent since spring (food diary most days, bike/walking/jogging 3–4x/week). Frustrated: weight 110.3 kg today vs 113.1 kg when the lifestyle plan began (-2.5%) despite reported adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 110.3 kg, BMI 37.3. BP 118/79.
